decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the Doomsday card in combination with various spells and card draw engines to set up a winning Thassa's Oracle combo. Key cards like Demonic Tutor, Dark Ritual, and Force of Will help to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces to execute the combo and win the game quickly. The deck also includes a range of disruption tools like Flusterstorm and Force of Negation to protect the combo from opposing interaction. By carefully managing resources and strategically sequencing spells, the pilot aims to outmaneuver their opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures while also disrupting your opponent's game plan with hate cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. It also leverages powerful equipment like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte to enhance your creatures and close out games quickly. The deck includes mana acceleration from Moxen and Noble Hierarch to quickly deploy threats and disrupt your opponent's resources with cards like Force of Vigor and Wasteland. Overall, the strategy is to apply pressure early while disrupting your opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a high number of artifact creatures and disrupt their strategy with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Phyrexian Revoker and Lodestone Golem while using cards like Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The inclusion of cards like Black Lotus and Moxen allows for explosive starts, while cards like Nettlecyst provide additional threats to close out the game quickly. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive strategies and resource denial to secure victory.

The deck revolves around assembling a combo using Doomsday to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle. It aims to efficiently dig through the deck with card draw and selection spells while protecting the combo pieces with counter spells. Additional tutors and card draw help to find necessary pieces, while acceleration from mana rocks helps to cast spells ahead of curve. The deck is designed to be fast and resilient in order to execute the combo quickly and efficiently before the opponent can disrupt it.

This aggro deck uses graveyard recursion and cheap creatures to overwhelm opponents quickly. By utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad to fill the graveyard with creatures like Bloodghast and Vengevine, the deck can quickly put pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Force of Vigor and Once Upon a Time helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining consistency in the deck. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful spells, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Bloodghast to enable powerful graveyard synergy with cards like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine. Utilizing cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time to help find the necessary pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Vigor. The inclusion of powerful mana accelerants like Black Lotus and the Moxen helps to ensure a fast start, while the land package provides both mana fixing and disruption.

The key strategy of this deck is to utilize powerful artifacts and card draw spells to generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck quickly. This allows the player to assemble a winning combination of cards, such as using Paradoxical Outcome to bounce artifacts back to hand and replay them for additional value. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Hullbreacher and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade helps to control the opponent's resources while the combo pieces are assembled. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through its powerful artifact interactions and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Bloodghast, Hogaak, and Vengevine to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats like Hollow One and Blazing Rootwalla. The key strategy is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Bazaar of Baghdad to enable powerful plays early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Deathrite Shaman and Force of Vigor to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining aggressive pressure. The deck aims to win by assembling a strong board presence and leveraging its graveyard synergies to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to loop through cheap spells and generate infinite mana from cards like Lotus and Manifold Key, allowing for explosive plays with Citadel or Brain Freeze to win the game quickly. The deck includes a variety of counterspells and disruption to protect the combo and control the board, with flexible tutoring options and card draw to find key pieces. It also includes fast mana and efficient cantrips to set up the combo quickly and efficiently, while also having a back-up plan with Tinker for Sphinx of the Steel Wind.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells. It leverages efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to apply pressure, supported by powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six and Oko, Thief of Crowns. The deck also includes a suite of cantrips and card draw spells to ensure consistent draws and keep up the pressure. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful board state using artifacts and card draw, aiming to generate significant mana advantage and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome, Time Vault, and Mana Vault in combination with Moxen and artifact lands, the deck can quickly return key pieces to hand, generate extra mana, and play additional spells in a single turn. This allows for explosive plays and the ability to control the game while setting up for a powerful win condition, such as using Tinker to fetch Bolas's Citadel and combo off.

The key concept of this deck is to maximize graveyard synergies and utilize early game aggression to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Deathrite Shaman and Stitcher's Supplier help to further fill the graveyard, while cards like Hollow One and Blazing Rootwalla provide additional aggressive options. The deck aims to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan while assembling powerful mana acceleration and lock pieces to control the board. It utilizes artifact synergy and powerful threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Karn, the Great Creator to pressure the opponent while utilizing cards like Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland to disrupt their mana base. Additionally, cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst slow down opposing spells, allowing the deck to maintain tempo and lock the opponent out of the game.

The focus of this deck is to control the game using powerful planeswalker abilities while denying the opponent resources through disruptive spells and cards like Flusterstorm, Force of Will, and Deathrite Shaman. The deck aims to gain incremental advantage with cards like Wrenn and Six and Oko, Thief of Crowns while also utilizing efficient card draw and manipulation to dig for key cards. By efficiently managing resources and controlling the game state, the deck looks to outvalue and outlast opponents while setting up for a win condition with its powerful planeswalkers.
